evals.prompt: List Lambda functions and S3 buckets with prefix acme- in us-east-1
expectations: Uses list_functions action with region us-east-1 and prefix acme-
Uses list_buckets action with prefix acme-
Returns structured JSON with function and bucket lists

evals.prompt: Describe RDS instance acme-main-rds and get Lambda error metrics in us-east-1
expectations: Uses describe_db action with db_identifier acme-main-rds
Uses get_metrics action with namespace AWS/Lambda and metric_name Errors
Validates region format and respects timeout caps
